import urllib.request,json,concurrent.futures,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/downloads')
def fetch(item):
 name,url=item
 try:
  urllib.request.urlretrieve(url,root/name)
  return {'file':name,'bytes':(root/name).stat().st_size}
 except Exception as e:return {'file':name,'error':repr(e)}
items=[('java-arm64.tar.gz','https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/21/ga/linux/aarch64/jre/hotspot/normal/eclipse'),('audiveris.deb','https://github.com/Audiveris/audiveris/releases/download/5.11.0/Audiveris-5.11.0-ubuntu22.04-x86_64.deb')]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 results=list(pool.map(fetch,items))
(root/'download-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(results))
